title: The Case of the Fast Clock
story: Jonah sets his watch by the big clock over the ferry dock, so when someone nudged it ten minutes fast, the ferry left early and stranded the town moderator on the dock, briefcase in hand. The clock hangs too high to reach without something to stand on. Five people came by the dock the evening before, each carrying something different and wearing a different hat. Who set the clock ahead?

question.text: Who set the dock clock fast?
